About.title: About me
About.subtitle: A mathematician by training, a software engineer by choice.
About.bio: I'm a Computer Networks Technician, graduated in Mathematics, and hold a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering, working in full-stack development for several years. Throughout my career, I've contributed to corporate systems across segments like food delivery, payroll-deductible credit, and booking platforms, working with technologies such as Vue.js, Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Python, and Django. I currently work as an Analyst Developer II at Qintess, contributing to systems used by Brazil's Ministry of Justice. I have a strong interest in software architecture, Clean Code, and Design Patterns, and I use tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code daily to ship better code, faster, without compromising quality.

items.description: Supporting systems used by Brazil's Ministry of Justice, updating branches and deployments via Azure DevOps, supporting a payment system with facial recognition, and building landing pages and CRM systems using Claude Code and the Spec-Driven Development methodology. Technologies: DBeaver, Java, Spring Boot, Python, Django, Angular, Vue.js, and Keycloak.
Supported a payroll-deductible loan simulation system (FGTS), versioning and deploying systems to testing and production environments. Technologies: Vue.js, Pinia, Tailwind CSS, Quasar, and Vite.

Developed booking management systems for rooms, parking spaces, tables, and lockers, created unit tests, customized system styling, and reviewed code. Technologies: Vue.js, Vuex, Vue Material, and Test Utils.
Built payroll-deductible credit sales and dialer management systems, including analytics dashboards and a status-verification API. Technologies: Vue.js, Vuex, and Quasar Framework.
Taught mathematics to young apprentices at the Administrative City of Minas Gerais.
Built a food delivery restaurant management system, an order-status verification API, a card reconciliation system, and automated microservices. Technologies: AngularJS, PHP, SQL, and Oracle.
Built screens for a food delivery restaurant management software and handled branch versioning on GitLab. Technologies: AngularJS, PHP, SQL, and Oracle.
